question.text: The independent valuer appointed for valuation of a Category III AIF's investments must NOT be:

answer.text: A Registered Valuer under Companies Act Section 247
An associate of the manager, sponsor, or trustee of the AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the independent valuer shall not be an associate of the manager, sponsor or trustee of the AIF. This is the only status-based bar in the eligibility criteria. The Trap: Options A, B and C are not barred merely by professional status, provided the valuer otherwise satisfies the workbook's eligibility criteria; only association with the manager, sponsor or trustee is prohibited. Note: Based on Series-XIX-E workbook p.339, which sets out the independent-valuer eligibility criteria.
